approval.approved_statement: The maintainer explicitly requested a new release from current main and installation on all devices, HA development and HA production.
approval.effect: Deploy the exact current-main Core artifact below to HA production after development validation; run separate target-scoped smoke. Preserve pairing, profile data and recoverable rollback.

constraints: Internal release only; no public HACS promotion or App Store/TestFlight submission.
Exact source CI and qualification passed; TDE complexity policy remains failed and does not establish a critical product defect.
Retain previously documented real-provider, editorial and physical product acceptance limits; installation and smoke do not certify those.
Back up production configuration and retain previous integration before installation.
Preserve existing pairing and Profile data; keep rollback outside custom_components.
next_authorized_action: After HA-dev validation, dispatch private-network deployment and separate matching smoke for the exact binding.
